item.title: Hospital group moves its warehouse to the lakehouse
item.dc:creator: Ana Ruiz
item.content:encoded:
A regional hospital group said on Monday it will move its reporting warehouse to a lakehouse over the next year, citing the cost of keeping two copies of clinical data in sync. The chief data officer said the project starts with finance and staffing reports before clinical analytics follow in the spring.

Vendors were not named.
